articleBodyHtml:
Broadcast Continuation and Celebration Break

The broadcast is ongoing and will be followed by a special break to celebrate. The audience is encouraged to watch the broadcast together.

Special Mentions and Greetings

OKAYO-senpai is involved, and Kiara will deliver a greeting in German. There is a confirmation request for Kiara's German greeting. Kiara says 'Auf Wiedersehen' multiple times, and the audience finds it cute.

Personal Reflections and Experiences

The speaker was initially hesitant about interacting with Hololive but has since adjusted. Living abroad helped the speaker gain confidence and attract an audience. Accepting their 3D face contributed to their confidence.

Language and Cultural References

The speaker attempted to imitate a baby and referenced Zumei-senpai's English studies. The speaker claims to easily understand any language, including 'I love you'. The speaker finds the word 'I love you' to be a good word and describes a citrus aroma. The speaker likes the word 'I love you' and asks about Kiara's aroma color.

Cute Moments and Previous Conversations

The speaker found a conversation segment cute and struggled to follow it. The speaker was referencing a previous conversation about Mana.

Engagement and Concentration

The speaker expresses difficulty concentrating when not actively engaged.

Desirable Experiences and Questions

The speaker mentions the Hololive Tour as a desirable experience. The speaker wants to discuss a specific question with the listener.

Imagination, Color, and Commitment

The speaker invites the listener to use their imagination. The speaker specifies a color. The speaker expresses a commitment to effort. The speaker celebrates a 1st anniversary. The speaker vows to evolve their hodotoku.
